zh.title: 瑞士國際航空波音777因異味轉降亞速爾群島
zh.summary: 瑞士國際航空波音777客機因機上異味轉降亞速爾群島；業者已派替換機接載旅客
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）的一架波音777客機，因機上出現不明異味而轉降至亞速爾群島。此次突發轉降事件導致機上旅客滯留於亞速爾群島。
根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 25 日的報導，航空公司已派遣一架替換用波音777客機前往亞速爾群島。該架救援替代客機正在途中，準備接載滯留的旅客繼續後續行程。
航空公司派出替換客機，旨在儘快協助受影響旅客完成旅程。目前關於該架波音777客機上不明異味之具體成因，報導中並未進一步說明。

en.title: SWISS Boeing 777 Diversion to Azores Caused by Mystery Odor Onboard
en.summary: SWISS Boeing 777 diverted to Azores over mystery odor; replacement aircraft dispatched to collect stranded passengers.
body: A SWISS Boeing 777 aircraft was forced to divert to the Azores after an unidentified mystery odor was detected on board. The unexpected landing left the passengers stranded at the airport while operational arrangements were made.

According to news reports from Simple Flying on August 25, 2026, a replacement Boeing 777 aircraft was dispatched and is currently on its way to the Azores. The replacement aircraft will pick up the stranded passengers to allow them to resume their travel.

The airline sent the replacement aircraft as an immediate response to resolve the passenger disruption caused by the diversion in the Azores. Further details regarding the cause of the mystery odor on the SWISS Boeing 777 have not been publicly detailed.

zh.title: 聯合航空公布A321XLR首批國際航線
zh.summary: 聯合航空宣布12月起以A321XLR飛航阿姆斯特丹與都柏林
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）於8月25日在紐瓦克自由國際機場（EWR）宣布，其空中巴士A321XLR（ICAO機型代碼A21N）的首批國際航班將於2026年12月1日起營運。這些航線將從華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場（IAD）出發，飛往荷蘭阿姆斯特丹和愛爾蘭都柏林。
該航空公司表示，A321XLR航程約4,700海浬，並計畫於2026年9月起先開通國內航線。此外，聯合航空也公布2027年夏季新增10個目的地，其中5個將由A321XLR營運，包括從紐瓦克飛往盧森堡市（LUX）、伊維薩（IBZ）、瓦倫西亞（VLC）、馬賽（MRS），以及從杜勒斯飛往土魯斯（TLS）。
根據ch-aviation資料，聯合航空目前僅接收一架A321XLR，尚未投入商業營運；公司預計到2026年底再接收5架。

en.title: United confirms first international destinations for ‘Born to Explore’ A321XLR
en.summary: United Airlines will start A321XLR flights to Amsterdam and Dublin from December 1, 2026.
body: United Airlines announced on August 25, 2026, at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) that its first international Airbus A321XLR flights will start on December 1, 2026. The new aircraft will operate from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) to Amsterdam and Dublin, following the opening of domestic routes in September 2026.

The Airbus A321XLR can fly up to around 4,700 nautical miles. United also introduced 10 new destinations for summer 2027, five of which will be operated by the A321XLR. These include services from Newark to Luxembourg City (LUX), Ibiza (IBZ), Valencia (VLC), and Marseille (MRS), and from IHD to Toulouse Airport (TLS).
According to ch-aviation, United has so far taken delivery of only one Airbus A321XLR, which has not yet entered commercial service. The airline expects to receive five more by the end of 2026.

zh.title: 中國S4000浮空風力發電系統完成13123英呎高度飛行測試
zh.summary: 中國S4000高空風力發電系統完成全流程飛行測試；運作高度達4000公尺。
body: 中國升級版「S4000平流層浮空風力發電系統」（SAWES）日前在中國西北地區的試驗基地完成全流程飛行測試。根據報導，該系統在測試中達到了13,123英呎（約合4,000公尺）的運作高度，標誌著高空風力發電技術驗證取得全新突破。
本次飛行測試對S4000系統的完整運轉流程進行了驗證，內容包含平台升空、空中定點保持、發電運轉以及受控回收等階段。相關測試數據顯示，各項關鍵技術指標均達到預期標準，將支援該技術在複雜高空環境下的進一步開發與部署。
S4000系統採用類似飛艇的浮空平台設計，透過大型囊體在空中保持浮力，並攜帶發電設備獲取平流層附近較強且穩定的風力資源。發電設備在飛行中所產生的電力，會經由纜線傳輸至地面，該纜線同時在運作期間起到了協助固定平台位置的作用。
作為先前S2000平台的升級版本，S4000在結構配置上進行了優化，旨在提升整體運能並具備直接接入主幹電網的能力。該系統的設計使用壽命最高可達20年，適用於地形或空間受限而無法設置傳統地面風力發電機組的區域。
在此之前，前代S2000系統曾於2026年1月在四川省進行測試飛行，當時攀升至約6,560英呎（約2,000公尺）的高度，並成功產生385千瓦時的電力，直接傳輸至當地電網。S4000系統即是在前代研發基礎上進一步提升運轉高度與系統性能。

en.title: China's S4000 Airborne Wind Turbine System Completes 13,123-Foot Altitude Flight Test
en.summary: China's upgraded S4000 airborne wind energy system completed a flight test at 13,123 feet altitude.
body: China’s upgraded S4000 Stratosphere Airborne Wind Energy System (SAWES) has completed a full-process flight test at a trial base located in Northwest China. During the flight test, the airborne platform reached an operational altitude of 13,123 feet, or approximately 4,000 meters, marking progress in stratospheric wind power technology.

The trial validated the airborne system’s full operating sequence, which encompasses ascent, station-keeping at altitude, electricity generation, and controlled recovery. All key performance indicators reportedly satisfied required standards, paving the way for further development of the airborne energy platform in complex high-altitude environments.

Designed as a floating airship-like platform, the S4000 uses a large helium envelope to remain aloft while carrying power generation equipment to tap stronger and more consistent wind resources higher in the atmosphere. Power generated aloft is transmitted to the ground through a tether, which also maintains platform positioning during operation.

The S4000 represents an upgraded configuration building on the earlier S2000 system, designed to boost overall operational performance while connecting directly to mainstream power grids. With a design service life of up to 20 years, the technology aims to provide airborne power generation in areas where conventional ground-based wind turbines face geographic limitations.

This test follows real-world demonstrations of the predecessor S2000 platform, which completed a flight test over Sichuan Province in January 2026. The S2000 reached an altitude of about 6,560 feet, or 2,000 meters, and generated 385 kilowatt-hours of electricity for the local grid, laying the foundation for the higher-altitude S4000 test.

zh.title: 紅箭2026賽季尾聲 公布剩餘表演行程
zh.summary: 英國紅箭特技飛行隊公布2026賽季剩餘表演日期與地點
body: 英國皇家空軍紅箭特技飛行隊（Red Arrows）公布2026年表演賽季剩餘行程，最後一次預定演出將於10月在IWM達克斯福德（IWM Duxford）舉行。
接下來先後有克拉克頓航展（8月27日至28日）、紹斯波特航展（8月29日至30日）、艾爾國際航展（9月4日至5日）、根西與澤西島表演（9月9日至10日），以及貝爾的薩尼科萊國際航展（9月13日）。
報導指出，表演可能因天氣、飛機可用性或作業需求而變動，建議觀眾查閱皇家空軍及活動主辦單位的最新資訊。

en.title: RAF Red Arrows release remaining 2026 display schedule, final show at IWM Duxford in October
en.summary: Red Arrows list remaining 2026 show dates from Clacton to Sanicole; final display at Duxford.
body: The Royal Air Force Aerobatic Team, the Red Arrows, has published the remaining display schedule for its 2026 season, with the final scheduled appearance at IWM Duxford in October.

Upcoming shows include Clacton Airshow on 27 and 28 August, Southport Air Show on 29 and 30 August, Ayr Air Show on 4 and 5 September, Guernsey and Jersey displays on 9 and 10 September, and the International Sanicole Airshow in Belgium on 13 September.
The RAF notes that displays can change due to weather, aircraft availability and operational requirements, and advises checking the RAF and event organisers for the latest information.

zh.title: 柯林斯完成F-35 EPACS高空測試
zh.summary: 柯林斯完成EPACS高空測試；潛在解決F-35冷卻問題
body: 柯林斯航太（Collins Aerospace，RTX旗下子公司）已完成為F-35戰機開發的增強動力與冷卻系統（EPACS）的高空測試，使這項潛在解決方案距離成熟更進一步。
該公司表示，EPACS的目標是作為現有系統的潛在替代方案，並已展示80kW的冷卻能力，超過目前系統容量的兩倍。
柯林斯航太動力與控制事業部環境與機身控制系統副總裁Ira Grimmett表示：「完成此階段測試，推進EPACS成熟度，並增強對系統能力與性能的信心。」
依據2023年政府問責署（GAO）的報告，F-35現有冷卻系統負荷過重，導致引擎磨損增加、壽命縮短，並增加380億美元的維護成本。

en.title: Collins completes altitude testing of EPACS as potential F-35 cooling fix
en.summary: Collins Aerospace completes EPACS altitude testing; potential F-35 cooling fix advances
body: Collins Aerospace, a subsidiary of RTX, has announced the completion of altitude testing for its Enhanced Power and Cooling System (EPACS), moving a potential solution for the F-35's power and thermal management problem closer to maturity.
The system is intended as a potential replacement for the current system, and has demonstrated 80kW of cooling, more than double its present capacity.

Ira Grimmett, vice-president of Environmental & Airframe Control Systems for Power & Controls at Collins Aerospace, said: "Completing this phase of testing advances EPACS maturity and reinforces confidence in the system's capability and performance."
A 2023 Government Accountability Office (GAO) report noted that the F-35's existing cooling system is overtasked, increasing engine wear and adding $38 billion in maintenance costs.

zh.title: Mammoth交付首架波音777-200LRMF改裝貨機
zh.summary: Mammoth交付首架777-200LRMF改裝貨機；將加入DHL網絡營運
body: 飛機改裝公司 Mammoth Freighters 已正式達到其客機轉貨機（P2F）計畫的重要里程碑，將首架波音 777-200LRMF 貨機交付給飛機租賃商 Jetran。對 Mammoth Freighters 而言，這首架改裝飛機的交付標誌著 777-200LRMF 改裝計畫成功從研發與認證階段正式跨入商業營運階段。
本次交付給 Jetran 的改裝飛機註冊號為 N703DN，生產序號為 MSN 32222。該架飛機最初於 2009 年製造，先前曾由達美航空（Delta Air Lines）進行營運。作為 Mammoth 國際生產網絡的一部分，該機隨後在英國曼徹斯特的 STS Aviation Services 基地完成客改貨工程，並在準備投入服務前換上完整的 DHL 企業塗裝。
首架交付的改裝貨機預定交由 DHL Air UK 接收，並納入 DHL Express 的國際長途貨運網絡中運作。作為該改裝計畫的主要租賃商，Jetran 已累計訂購超過兩打 777-200LRMF 改裝貨機。未來幾年內，該計畫共有 13 架改裝飛機預計將進入 DHL Express 的全球網絡執行商業營運，其中有 4 架規劃於 2026 年底前完成交付。
Mammoth 開發的改裝技術旨在將波音 777-200LR 客機改裝為專門載運主艙貨物的專用貨機。改裝工程包含安裝大型主艙貨艙門、強化主艙地板結構，以及升級配置現代化貨物處理系統。在技術性能方面，改裝後的 777-200LRMF 擁有約 104,800 公斤的獲認證酬載能力，並可在最大酬載狀況下提供約 4,800 海里的航程能力。

en.title: Mammoth Freighters Delivers First Converted Boeing 777-200LRMF to Jetran
en.summary: Mammoth Freighters delivers its first converted Boeing 777-200LRMF freighter to Jetran for operation with DHL.
body: Mammoth Freighters has officially reached a significant milestone in its passenger-to-freighter conversion program by delivering its first Boeing 777-200LRMF cargo aircraft to aircraft leasing firm Jetran. For Mammoth Freighters, this initial delivery marks the formal transition of the 777-200LRMF conversion program from its engineering development and flight certification phases directly into active commercial operation.

The specific aircraft handed over to Jetran carries the registration N703DN and serial number MSN 32222. Originally manufactured in 2009 and previously operated in passenger service by Delta Air Lines, the jet was subsequently converted into a dedicated freighter at the STS Aviation Services facility in Manchester, United Kingdom, as part of Mammoth Freighters' expanding international production network, emerging in full DHL livery ahead of its operational deployment.

This initial converted freighter is destined for DHL Air UK, where it will be integrated into the international long-haul air express network operated by DHL Express. Jetran serves as the launch customer and lessor for the program, having ordered more than two dozen 777-200LRMF freighters in total. Thirteen aircraft from this conversion program are scheduled to enter revenue service across the global DHL Express network over the coming years, with four of those aircraft slated to arrive by the end of 2026.

The conversion process designed by Mammoth Freighters transforms passenger Boeing 777-200LR airframes into dedicated cargo freighters optimized for main-deck payload carriage. Technical modifications to the airframe include the installation of a large main-deck cargo door, a reinforced main-deck floor structure, and a modern cargo-handling system. According to program performance specifications, the 777-200LRMF features a certified payload capability of approximately 104,800 kilograms and provides an operational range of around 4,800 nautical miles at maximum payload weight.
